name: Sakuya
source:
An android created by Akane's father. There are a few oddities that are apparent in his feelings and speech, but other than that, the workings of his brain are identical to a human's. He has a calm and composed personality, and has his own distinct pace. He hardly ever shows negative emotions. Since he rarely leaves the house, Sakuya is responsible for all of the housework. His hobbies are reading and watching movies, both of which are sources of his knowledge.

[Translation of the [URL=http://tetrascope.skr.jp/sakuya/chara_sakuya.html]official website's character profile[/URL].]
